Author quantitative literature source representations

Source: R/source-literature.R
glyhub_literature_sources.Rd

Selected author quantitative source representations preserve their signed scales and record grain or alternative method outputs without forcing a curated matrix.

Details

Use glyhub_catalog with kind = "raw" and glyhub_load with the same kind. The result is a hash-verified file path, not an SE. These source-file entries have no same-named convenience function; some have separate curated objects. Here "raw" denotes the source asset, not raw spectra or unprocessed intensity. Of the 32 source entries released in data-v0.2.0, 24 retain original source bytes and eight are explicitly deidentified RDS derivatives. The latter contain unchanged quantitative values and necessary analysis groups, but omit original subject labels and individual clinical covariates. No original-to-new subject map is published. This is not a guarantee against re-identification from public data. Entries download from data-v0.2.0 and are verified by size and SHA-256.

PXD019914 provides glyhub_PXD019914_N_Intact_AuthorProcessed (15,512 by 129) and glyhub_PXD019914_N_SPEG_AuthorProcessed (5,115 by 129). Each deidentified RDS retains the selected numerical values and biological feature annotations. Measurements are author-normalized log2 ratios: 119 TCGA tumors plus ten explicitly labelled quality controls, not 129 independent patients. Original negative values, zeros and missing values are unchanged. SPEG is deglycosite data, not intact glycoform abundance. Separate Intact_RelativeRatios and SPEG_RelativeRatios curated objects apply 2^x specifically to this study's explicitly log2-normalized ratios, retaining original log2 values in metadata. Source zero becomes one; missing values remain missing. This does not recover raw intensity or undo the author's normalization. Other signed sources below remain source-only without an inverse transformation.

MSV000086576 provides glyhub_MSV000086576_N_HCC_AuthorProcessed (1,831 by 7) and glyhub_MSV000086576_N_PDAC_AuthorProcessed (2,525 by 12). These are deidentified RDS derivatives with logged, reference-relative and median-normalized TMT measurements. HCC has four normal and three tumor channels; PDAC has six explicitly labelled tumor/normal pairs. The author 75-percent detection filter is not reapplied. Core-fucose and PNGaseF flags remain distinct annotations.

MSV000084262 provides glyhub_MSV000084262_N_XMEN_AuthorProcessed (2,073 by 6), a deidentified RDS derivative. Author UID-expanded deamidated peptide/site rows are not collapsed to unique protein sites. Three XMEN and three healthy T-cell samples retain study-local labels and groups; clinical identities are not guessed. Signed values have undocumented additional processing beyond the paper's log2 description, so they must not be relabelled linear intensity or exponentiated.

Additional source files preserve pGlyco3 multi-run GPSMs (including O-glyco HEK293), mucinase enzyme-digest AUC records, alternative GlycanFinder search outputs, HG-TCs reporter tables, NB4 per-sample tables, BOCTAG protein groups, and OxoScan feature-by-participant records. Source identities and alternative quantification metrics are not collapsed or interpreted as independent cohorts.

Repository CC0 source files additionally include HCC/IgG quantitative records, retina sWGA-enriched ordinary precursors, ConA-enriched muscle precursors, and HCC 18O site groups. Four biofluid EV original files are withheld pending clarification of subject linkage; they are not registered public source assets. These enrichments do not prove every captured peptide is a localized glycosite. Glyco-DIA TrueT and FakeT files are two library-search controls of one run; FakeT hits are not asserted biological glycoforms. Historically skipped deSA data are not reopened. Unknown glycan types are explicitly missing, not N.

Installed provenance, source scales, mapping and licence evidence are also available at system.file("extdata", "literature-source-metadata.json", package="glyhub"). Exact input URLs, SHA-256, sheet/column coordinates, sample mapping, scale caveats, licensing basis and build instructions are maintained in the accession-specific data-raw/ directories and source receipts in the repository. PXD019914 and MSV000086576 use original-author CC BY 4.0 supplemental tables; XMEN uses the independent MassIVE CC0 deposit, not the publisher's licence.
